_note: A SAMPLE of the SHAPE of the Fire Dragon Slayer tree, for tools/skilltree/preview_skilltree.py only. The real route is data/nusmp/skill_trees/fire_dragon_slayer.json (owned by the Fairy Tail builder); this file follows the same schema (docs/skilltree/design.md section 2) with the owner's shape: 9 nodes, two branches (ranged above, melee below), passives in the middle and a Secret Art that needs the end of both branches.
name: Fire Dragon Slayer
desc: The lost magic that teaches a mage to eat flame and to breathe it back.
book_lore: A dusty tome sought by every mage who was told his class was not enough.

nodes.name: Fire Dragon's Iron Fist
nodes.desc: A fist wrapped in flame. The first thing every Dragon Slayer learns, and the root of everything below it.

nodes.name: Fire Dragon's Roar
nodes.desc: Breathes a cone of flame in front of the caster.

nodes.name: Fire Dragon's Brilliant Flame
nodes.desc: Gathers both fists into a ball of fire and throws it.

nodes.name: Fire Dragon's Claw
nodes.desc: A flaming kick that rakes everything in front of the mage.

nodes.name: Fire Dragon's Wing Attack
nodes.desc: Two arcs of flame sweep out from the mage's arms.

nodes.name: Dragon Scales
nodes.desc: Passive. Flame-scaled skin shrugs off a share of fire damage.

nodes.name: Flame Eater
nodes.desc: Passive. Standing in fire restores the mage instead of hurting them.

nodes.name: Crimson Lotus: Exploding Flame Blade
nodes.desc: The Secret Art. Both fists blaze into swords and cross in one great cut. Needs the Roar and the Claw both at their peak.

nodes.name: Dragon Force
nodes.desc: The limit of a Dragon Slayer: for a short time every technique above hits harder.
